title: rules.version.draft-updated.v1
description: Written to the Rule Engine outbox in the transaction where the author of a DRAFT version replaces its document in place (PUT .../versions/{v}, RLE-047). The version keeps its number and stays a DRAFT; nothing is published. The outbox row id is the event id. Additive changes only within v1 (DESIGN section 3.3).

version.description: Version number of the rule set, not the lock version.

tenantId.description: The tenant, from the authenticated context; never from a request body.

actor.description: Who sent the command; always equal to updatedBy.

occurredAt.description: When the replacement committed, ISO 8601 UTC.

updatedBy.description: The draft's author, the only identity allowed to replace it.

canonicalHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical document after the replacement, lower-case hex.

previousCanonicalHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical document before the replacement, lower-case hex.
